sites.note: gameapplication.cpp checksum gate: test eax,eax -> xor eax,eax, forcing the setcc result (achievements allowed) true. Register byte wildcarded; anchored to the func that logs 'Active Mod Count:' so only the real gate matches.
Legacy-preserving: eu4application.cpp + checksum-helper sites (test eax,eax; sete bl; call). Both patched test->xor, matching the original tool's behavior.

EU5 1.4.7: setter of the achievement condition 'not using another player's savegame' (ACHIEVEMENTS_CONDITION_SAVEGAME, byte +0x130 of the achievement-state singleton). movzx ebx,byte[rdx] -> mov bl,1; nop, so loading a save made by another Steam user keeps achievements eligible. Touches only this one condition. The previous can_get_achievements flag-chain site no longer matches 1.4.7.
